sa-01: Glory to Shiva Omkara — Brahma, Vishnu and Sadashiva, who bears the Goddess as half his body.
sa-02: One-faced, four-faced and five-faced they shine — with swan, Garuda and the bull as their mounts.
sa-03: Two arms, four arms, ten arms — seeing the three forms, the three worlds are enchanted.
sa-04: Rosary of seeds, forest-garland, rudraksha mala — Tripurari's hand is adorned with the auspicious serpent.
sa-05: White cloth, yellow cloth, tiger-skin — Sanaka and the sages, Garuda, and the spirit-hosts attend.
sa-06: In hand the water-pot, discus and trident — giver of joy, taker of sorrow, protector of the world.
sa-07: Even the unknowing know Brahma, Vishnu and Sadashiva; in the syllable Om the one Imperishable shines.
sa-08: Shiva's comparison is with the boundless stars; crown, earrings and ornaments shine at the throat.
